description: Feature-flag register (plan step F15), checked in CI by scripts/check_flag_register.py. One row per flag-shaped setting the code reads (see scan.pattern): the default as the code declares it ((unset) when the read has no literal default, (varies) when read sites disagree), an owning team or role ("platform" when unknown), and an expiry: an ISO date by which the owner removes the flag or moves the date with a reason, or "permanent" with a reason for operational settings. Remove a flag and its row together. not_flags lists flag-shaped names that are not settings.
